title: Source: Morgan Stanley is pitching data center developers to use leveraged loans rather than bonds, and estimates ~$15B will be issued in 2026 in such loans (Dakin Campbell/The Information)
summary: Dakin Campbell / The Information: Source: Morgan Stanley is pitching data center developers to use leveraged loans rather than bonds, and estimates ~$15B will be issued in 2026 in such loans — Morgan Stanley, one of the most active banks in financing data center developers, is now pitching some of those same clients …
